prohibited_uses: extrapolation to other fuels or PMMA formulations without evidence
claim that gravity alone caused an observed difference

source_identity.pass_when: Source, investigation and source location are traceable.

claim_statistic_integrity.pass_when: Mean, maximum, median, steady-state and transient values remain explicitly distinguished.

run_identity.pass_when: Both results are linked to exact run/sample identifiers and source assets.

observable_equivalence.pass_when: Physical quantity, operational definition, spatial/temporal basis, statistic and processing method are comparable or bridged by a validated method.

material_geometry.pass_when: Material formulation, actual dimensions and relevant geometric conditions are characterized or validly bounded.

material_properties.pass_when: Required thermophysical properties are available with provenance and uncertainty.

atmosphere_flow.pass_when: Run-specific composition, pressure, flow type, direction, velocity and reference location are established or validly bridged.

regime_validity.pass_when: Thermal-regime assumptions and distance from kinetic/radiative boundaries are independently assessed.

mechanism_relevance.pass_when: The source finding concerns a mechanism relevant to the selected target phenomenon.

boundary_conditions.pass_when: Holder/contact heat transfer, ignition history, confinement, flow conditioning and support effects are quantified or bounded.

measurement_reconstruction.pass_when: Raw/reduced data, calibration, frame timing, threshold/settings and fit window support reproducible rate reconstruction.

uncertainty_and_reproducibility.pass_when: FiF-specific uncertainty is calculated and processing can be independently reproduced.

independent_validation_data.pass_when: Validation observations are independent of model calibration data.

domain_statement.pass_when: The permitted domain, assumptions and prohibited extrapolations are explicit.

case_rules.effect: Preserve NASA Section 2.3 values as source-reported summary values; preserve 2.0 mm/s average and 2.2 mm/s microgravity maximum as different statistic types.
Preserve 2 cm/s (B3 Appendix A.1) and 3 cm/s (Section 2.3) as separate conflicting assertions; block B3-specific quantitative linkage.
Do not link B3/sample 148 to the Section 2.3 2.2 mm/s value without an explicit source join.
Ground 100-µm result lacks run/sample/video linkage in the audited evidence; block matched-run validation.
Retain Figure 2.20 nominal oxygen caption and B3 calibrated/uncalibrated sensor readings as separate assertions.
Target 100-µm image-analysis threshold is unknown; do not substitute threshold 30 or 70 from other cases.
Unknown PMMA grade/batch and thermal properties block model validation that requires those properties.
Different holder and ignition arrangements require transient exclusion and boundary-condition assessment; gravity-only causality is prohibited.
Store NASA's thermal-regime interpretation as source-reported; FiF's independent regime gate remains partial.
Store NASA's reported <5% uncertainty/reproducibility as source-reported, never as FiF-measured uncertainty.
No target videos have been independently reconstructed by FiF; quantitative validation remains insufficient.
Nominal PMMA, thickness, width and atmosphere similarity permits a qualified literature-level comparison, not full physical equivalence.

decision_policy.conflict_semantics: An unresolved source conflict is an evidence problem, not automatically a physical incompatibility.
decision_policy.statistic_semantics: A maximum and a mean are not equivalent statistics. A request to treat them as an equivalent quantitative pair is not transferable on current evidence.
